story.iWant: to interact with the narrative questions in a "this or that" tournament bracket style
story.soThat: the quiz is engaging and my choices feel impactful

subtask.description: Define a userProfile prop for the component.
On component initialization, call selectNarrativeQuestions to get the 8 questions for the tournament.
Manage the state of the tournament, including the current round and the questions in each matchup.
In the first round, display the 4 matchups (8 questions).
In the second round, display the 2 matchups with the winning options from the first round.
In the final round, display the final matchup.
For the current matchup, display the two NarrativeAnswerOptions side-by-side as large, tappable cards.
Implement an on:click handler for each card to record the user's choice.
After a choice is made, advance to the next matchup or the next round.
Create a progress bar or a series of dots to indicate the user's current stage in the tournament (e.g., 'Round 1 of 3').
Use animations or transitions to make the progression feel smooth and engaging.
Use TailwindCSS and DaisyUI for a clean, mobile-first layout that emphasizes the two choices.
Create a Playwright test file for the narrative quiz flow.
Write a test that simulates a user completing the entire tournament bracket.
Assert that the correct options are advanced to the next round based on user selections.

acceptanceCriteria.ac: A Svelte component presents two narrative options side-by-side.
User taps on preferred option to advance.
Visual feedback indicates progression through the "bracket."

constraint.description: The UI component must be implemented using Svelte.
Styling must adhere to TailwindCSS and DaisyUI conventions for a clean, mobile-first "this or that" experience.
The new Svelte component should be created in `src/lib/components/narrative/`.
The component must receive a `UserProfile` object as a prop and use the `selectNarrativeQuestions` function to get the 8 questions for the tournament.
The UI must present questions in a "this or that" tournament bracket style, with clear visual feedback for progression.

tests.standards: End-to-end tests should be written using Playwright. Test files should be placed in the `e2e/` directory. Focus on simulating user interactions and asserting correct UI behavior and navigation through the tournament bracket.

ideas.idea: Write an end-to-end test that simulates a user completing the entire tournament bracket, asserting that the correct options are advanced to the next round based on user selections.
Write an end-to-end test to verify that the visual progression feedback (e.g., progress bar) updates correctly after each round.
Write an end-to-end test to verify the mobile responsiveness of the `NarrativeQuiz.svelte` component across different viewport sizes.
